Let’s compute step-by-step.

1. US/Pacific = UTC−8 (standard time, no DST mentioned).  
   Asia/Shanghai = UTC+8 (standard time, no DST mentioned).

2. Time difference: target_offset − source_offset = (+8) − (−8) = 16 hours.

3. Source time: 07:00 (August 25, 1248) + 16 hours = 23:00 same day (August 25, 1248).

No day wrap beyond 24:00 here, so final local time in Shanghai is 23:00 on August 25, 1248.

FINAL_ANSWER: 23:00
